name: Dropshipping Product Export for WooCommerce
author: wpdesk

sections.description:
Dropshipping Product Export for WooCommerce provides a comprehensive solution for exporting your WooCommerce product data. Whether you need a simple CSV file this plugin has you covered.

Configure multiple export templates, choose precisely which products and fields to include, and even automate your exports with the PRO version.

Unlock More Power with PRO:

Upgrade to Dropshipping Product Export for WooCommerce to unlock advanced features designed for professionals and demanding workflows:

  • [PRO] Conditional Logic: Export only the products that meet specific criteria based on:
    • Product selection (Include/Exclude specific products)
    • Product Attributes
    • Product Tags
    • Product Categories
    • Product Price ranges
    • Stock Status or Quantity
  • [PRO] Data Modification:
    • Apply Price Modifiers (e.g., increase/decrease by percentage or fixed amount).
    • Apply Stock Modifiers (e.g., set specific quantities or apply rules).
  • [PRO] Automation & Scheduling:
    • Set up automatic export schedules using WP-Cron.
    • Define custom file locations for saved export files.
    • Automatically export files directly to an FTP/SFTP server.
    • Specify the exact path on the FTP server.

Learn more about PRO Features!

Data usa policy

WP Desk plugins collect anonymous diagnostic and configuration data to enhance product quality, stability, and alignment with user needs. This data is securely transmitted once after plugin activation and once a week later on, to WP Desk’s servers at testsdata.wpdesk.org and data.wpdesk.org for statistical analysis, technical issue identification, and plugin performance optimization.

All data collection is conducted anonymously, without storing personal, financial, or sensitive business information. The application does not collect data without users’ knowledge. Data collection requires an users opt-in through the plugin settings.

Learn about Use of Data Policy by WP Desk Plugins.

Roadmap

We are continuously working on improving the plugin. Here are some features planned for future iterations:

  • [PRO] Custom Fields Export (Step 3): Add support for exporting data from popular custom field plugins like Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) and Yoast SEO metadata.
  • Share with User Roles (Step 4): Allow specific user roles to access and manage certain export templates.
  • [PRO] User Notifications (Step 4): Implement an option to notify specific users via email upon successful completion (or failure) of scheduled exports.

Go PRO

Take your product exports to the next level with Dropshipping Product Export for WooCommerce PRO!

  • Precision Filtering: Use powerful Conditional Logic.
  • Data Transformation: Modify prices and stock levels on the fly.
  • Full Automation: Schedule exports and send files directly via FTP.
  • Priority Support: Get faster assistance from our support team.
sections.faq:
Which export formats are supported in the free version?

The free version supports CSV formats.

Which product types can I export?

You can export Simple, Variable (including individual variations), External/Affiliate, and Grouped products.
